name: qkd_seq_core_st_r1-r1-COMMIT
purpose: Q-KVSYS PVJOIN 10-16 (lead-approved qkd_seq retirement): static control leaf of qkd_seq_static. Every store pop / aq start / Q beat / posted row / stream descriptor at a fixed edge after the compiled CMD slot of the static D2D end (link compiler), arrivals off-slot fault, landing row credits only checked. Bench: qkd_seq_static (this leaf + closed qkd_seq_xs_tp8 x4 + qkd_seq_fan x4) vs legacy qkd_seq on 36 link-slotted layers: aq 1188 / kvn 72 / kc 72 words per quadrant bit-identical, aq start at the compiled CMD+47 every layer (legacy +1 edge earlier, rows equal); mutants Q-beat swap / row t / start late / KVN push early FAIL.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_seq_core_static #(.MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_seq_static.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_kv_desc.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: seq_static_pass
bench.pass_regex: ^SEQ_STATIC PASS layers=36 aq=1188 kvn=72 kc=72 errors=0 mut=0 aq_start_from_cmd=47

bench.name: seq_static_mut_qswap
bench.fail_regex: ^SEQ_STATIC FAIL layers=36 aq=1188 kvn=72 kc=72 errors=288 mut=1

bench.name: seq_static_mut_late
bench.fail_regex: ^SEQ_STATIC FAIL layers=36 aq=1188 kvn=72 kc=72 errors=1 mut=3 aq_start_from_cmd=48
